title: Lightly Airfried Mediterranean Orange Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic Mediterranean dish featuring oranges, cooked to perfection in a cataplana vessel using the air fry function, with a blend of herbal notes and pillowy texture, perfect for a low sodium diet.
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, ginger, cumin, paprika, and salt free seasoning.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Load the chicken into the cataplana vessel, leaving some space between each piece for even cooking.
Air fry the chicken for 10 minutes, shaking the vessel halfway through.
Add the orange segments to the vessel and continue to air fry for an additional 5 minutes.
Stir in the chopped parsley and mint.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with additional parsley and mint if desired.
